items.stem: Why apply a heading style rather than manually bold and enlarge heading text?

options.text: Styles drive the navigation pane, the table of contents and consistent reformatting
options.rationale: Correct: styles are structural and feed navigation and the TOC.

options.text: Manual formatting is impossible in Word
options.rationale: It is possible, just not maintainable.
Styles are about structure, not size.

options.text: Bold text cannot appear in a heading
options.rationale: Bold can appear; the point is structure.

items.explanation: Correct: heading styles are structural and drive the navigation pane, the table of contents and consistent reformatting.
items.provenance: original Mastemy item drafted by an AI agent; no external question source

items.stem: Which TWO statements about Word building blocks and content controls are correct? (Select TWO.)

options.text: Building blocks (including AutoText) are reusable content stored in a template
options.rationale: Correct: building blocks live in a template and are reusable.

options.text: A content control can present a gallery of building blocks for insertion
options.rationale: Correct: a building-block gallery content control inserts stored blocks.

options.text: Building blocks can only be images
options.rationale: Building blocks can be text, tables, fields and more.

options.text: Content controls permanently lock the whole document
options.rationale: Content controls constrain a region, not the whole document.

items.explanation: Correct: building blocks are reusable template content, and a content control can surface them for insertion.

items.stem: What is the dependable way to produce a table of contents in a long report?

options.text: Generate it from the document's heading styles so it updates automatically
options.rationale: Correct: a generated TOC is built from heading styles and updates.

options.text: Type each entry and page number manually
options.rationale: A manual TOC does not update and drifts out of date.

options.text: Insert a screenshot of the headings
options.rationale: An image cannot be navigated or updated.
That is not a navigable, updating table of contents.

items.explanation: Correct: generate the table of contents from heading styles so it updates automatically.
